units: <cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 20:25">Num. R. s. 20</cite> <he>לא מן דובשיך לא מן עוּקְצִיךְ</he> I want neither thy honey nor thy sting; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 1:19">Midr. Till. to Ps. I, 5</cite> <he>מעוּקְצָךְ</he> … Y. Nâz. IX, 57ᵈ like fish that are fried, <he>רישיה דהן גבי עוּקְצֵיה דהן</he> the head of one by the side of the other’s tail.
<cite ref="Berakhot 58b:11">Ber. 58ᵇ</cite> <he>ע׳ דעקרבא</he> (Ar. <cite ref="P01164"><he>עקוסא</he></cite>) the prick (tail) of the Scorpio.

<cite ref="Eruvin 100b:12">Erub. 100ᵇ</cite> <he>דאית להו ע׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>דאית ליה עוּקְצֵי</he>; Ar. a. Ms. O. <cite ref="P00339"><he>עוקסא</he></cite>) when they (the shoes) have spurs (pegs in the sole); a. e.—Pl. <he>עוּקְצֵי</he>, v. supra.

<cite ref="Shabbat 106b:12">Sabb. 106ᵇ</cite> <he>כל היכא דליכא ע׳ ע׳ וכ׳</he> (Ms. O. <he>אוקסי</he>) a vivarium which is not divided off in recesses is called a small vivarium; <cite ref="Beitzah 24a:11">Bets. 24ᵃ</cite> (Ar. <he>אוקסי עוקסי</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 20).
